description: Starts an AI video on the signed-in account, opens the aicut card and returns the job id at once; it does NOT wait. WHEN: the user asks for a video. Call `list_models` first this session (an unpublished combination is rejected); see `get_recipe` `starter-video`. CONSENT: a real person's picture only with their permission, never a public figure or celebrity. `seedance-2.5` and `seedance-2.0-mini` often refuse a real person's image: say so BEFORE the ask, quote that it may be refused, and offer a generated character or another model. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: a video takes 1-3 minutes, up to about 6: do not assume it failed before then. COST: this spends the user's tokens. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

audio.description: Sound on the video, where supported (`list_models` says whether it costs extra). DEFAULTS TO FALSE: a model sold on native audio still renders SILENT unless set for the sound, dialogue or effects the user asked for. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

character_ids.description: Ids of this account's UPLOADED characters (`kind: "uploaded"` in `list_characters`, up to 20, in order of appearance): a start frame placing them is drawn first (flat 0.2 tokens, included in `estimate_only`), so not with `scenes` or references. A `cast_member` id belongs to `generate_story_video`.

duration.description: Seconds, one of the model's durations; longer costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (e.g. `kling-3.0`). Use the one the user asked for; never substitute a cheaper model to save them tokens.

prompt.description: What the video should show; `list_models` gives the character limit.

reference_audios.description: Audio the video performs to (lip-sync): `{url, start_seconds, end_seconds}` of an own generation or upload; windows 2-30 s each, 30 s in total, no window = the whole file. Only where `list_models` roles include `reference_audio`; not with start/end images.

reference_images.description: Image URLs for style or subject references, where the model accepts them; rules as `start_image`.

reference_videos.description: Reference video URLs, where the model accepts them: own media or a public video (imported), never another account's.

resolution.description: One of the model's options (e.g. `1080p`); higher costs more. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

scenes.description: A storyboard instead of one prompt, returned as ONE video. Only on models that publish it (today `kling-3.0`): at most 5 scenes, each 1-15s, 3-15s in total, else refused. Omit `prompt`/`duration`/`start_image`/`end_image`/`reference_images`; `model`, `resolution` and `aspect_ratio` stay REQUIRED. Priced as one generation of the combined duration; `estimate_only` first.

duration.description: This scene's own length in seconds.

prompt.description: This scene's own prompt: what happens in this shot.

start_image.description: Image URL to start from: a public https URL or this account's earlier generation.
